caller_authority: Tern next-task directive for MP-IMG4 (baseline 669fafca318944066596368e2ca73b37859d1781) under the Caller's resumption instruction and ADR-0014. Round-1 to round-3 review repairs are included.

profile.debug_note: The debug profile aborts with a main-thread stack overflow on this host regardless of this change (§19.214); native sets use release.

round_3_review_repairs: B-01: the admission decision now sums the live staging and in-flight reservations of every generation (plus each pool's stuck bytes) under the service lock and admits inside that lock, so two generations cannot each pass a per-pool check and together exceed the 64 MiB process budget; the quarantine ledger is checked separately because its payloads are already the pools' stuck bytes
A-01: the native ladder exercises the boundary at 32 MiB (refusal when retained == cap) and at the ratified 64 MiB default (three quarantined payloads, then refusal when the aggregate reaches 64 MiB)
A-02: drop counters are renamed to drop calls (drop_calls / atlas_drop_calls); GPUI accepts a drop for an absent entry, so a call count is not a proven removal count

A-03: the quarantine capacity is configurable through set_quarantine_capacity before the first render, with PROCESS_QUARANTINE_CAP_BYTES as the ratified default; the probe uses this to exercise the boundary
A-04: re-attaching the same consumer is idempotent success (the frame is retained and the consumer already owns it)

implementation.ownership: ConsumerId + attach/detach; attach binds the owning window before the first paint and is atomic with eviction; re-attach is idempotent. Every release path requires an empty consumer set.
implementation.eviction: evict refuses NotRetained, PaintInProgress, ConsumersRemain, NotOwnedByWindow and an exhausted budget before touching the atlas; it then calls Window::drop_image per tile, releases a never-uploaded admission, or quarantines an in-flight one against the process ledger.
implementation.budgets: process-wide staging and in-flight totals across generations are capped by the configured quarantine capacity (default 64 MiB), the quarantine ledger is capped by the same value, and new work is refused explicitly when either would be exceeded; no payload is released without measured termination.
implementation.window_close: evict_owned_by sweeps frames the window owns including pre-paint frames, reports evicted/skipped/unattributed/drop calls/released/quarantined, and leaves a consumer-held frame counted as skipped.
implementation.lazy_recreation: a new generation creates a pool on first use and resources are re-prepared on demand; an evicted identity paints PaintStatus::Evicted and a quarantined identity is refused as DuplicateRepresentation.

interactive.claim: Evict current reports atlas calls=16, released_staged=0 B, quarantined=16777216 B; reloading the same identity is refused with Admission(DuplicateRepresentation); Evict owned and close exits 0.
